 Priyanka Dasgupta Updated on 16 Nov 2026, 11:04 AM IST 
 The State Council of Educational Research and Training (SCERT) has released the NMMS Scholarship 2026-27 application form for states including Himachal Pradesh, Odisha, Telangana, West Bengal, Meghalaya, UP, Assam, and Nagaland. Interested students can apply online from the respective official websites. The selection process for the NMMS Scholarship includes a written test. Application forms for the NMMS Scholarship 2026-27 in other states will be released soon.

 NMMS Scholarship 2026-27 Apply Online
 Some states will also allow students to apply through their schools. Students currently studying in Class 8 in government, government-aided, or state board schools are eligible to apply online. Eligible students can complete the application process before the deadline set by their respective SCERTs. Those who qualify for the NMMS 2026-27 exam will get a scholarship of Rs 12000 per year. Read more to get details of the state-wise NMMS scholarship 2026-27 application process online here.
 State-Wise NMMS Scholarship Apply Online 2026-27
 The state-wise NMMS application forms are available here for students. Applicants must pay the required application fee and upload relevant documents to complete the application process. For some states like Goa, Arunachal Pradesh, Tamil Nadu, Nagaland, and Uttarakhand, the application form will be available offline.

 Students can follow the steps mentioned below to apply online for the NMMS Scholarship 2026-27. For the offline application, students need to collect their application forms from their respective schools.
 Visit the official website of the SCERT of the respective state.
 Click on the ‘ NMMS ’ section.
 Select the application form link.
 Generate the login credentials using basic details like name, email ID, phone number, etc.
 Next, log in with the generated details and fill out the application form.
 Enter your name, class, school name, and upload documents like Aadhaar card, school ID card, parents' annual income, etc.
 Pay the application fees and submit the application form.
 Save and download the confirmation slip for future reference.
